name: inertia-react-development
title_zh: React 页面写一半才想起 Inertia 的规矩
tagline_zh: 写 React 表单、导航、轮询时，它知道 Inertia 的每个坑：deferred props 何时该等。
tagline_en: Knows the rules for forms, links, deferred props, prefetching, optimistic updates. Writes React that fits.
desc_en: Develops Inertia.js v3 React client-side applications. Activates when creating React pages, forms, or navigation; using <Link>, <Form>, useForm, useHttp, setLayoutProps, or router; working with deferred props, prefetching, optimistic updates, instant visits, or polling; or when user mentions React with Inertia, React pages, React forms, or React navigation.
why_zh: 不是补全插件，是行为守则。它把 Inertia 的约定编成检查点，在你写错前拦下，而不是报错后解释。
why_en: It's a rulebook turned into live checks: catches convention violations as you type, not after a 500.
limit_zh: 只认 Inertia.js v3 + React 客户端。服务端、Vue 版、或纯 React 项目它不接手。
limit_en: Inertia.js v3 + React client only. No Vue, no server-side code, no pure React. Won't generate routes or controllers.
title_en: Inertia v3 React dev that catches your mistakes before the.
